name: World Digital Economy Asset Group Limited
summary: Serving as an investment holding company, China Supply Chain Holdings Limited specializes in providing building maintenance and renovation solutions within the Hong Kong region. It also extends administrative assistance. The company, which commenced operations in 2014 and is headquartered in Hong Kong, was rebranded from Yat Sing Holdings Limited to its current name in July 2020. China Supply Chain Holdings Limited operates as a subordinate entity of Smart Paradise International Limited.
